payload.goal: Board redline round 1 (the owner's 20-point ruleset): no footer, DRY header, 3-dot watchdog, LED iteration list oldest-first, agent tab strip (mallard), 3x3 fixed thirds, Wireshark table with direction columns, session-scoped log, details-pane fallback + filter help, maximize-everywhere, decisions pane with handover card, toll todo checklist — plus three laws into the served contract/voice: discuss-first, sketch-adherence, maximize rule.
payload.load_bearing_for: The board is the owner's only always-on window into agent work; today's design round caught it inventing elements beyond the owner's sketch and repeating state across panels — exactly the trust the board exists to build.
payload.exit_check: Engine verify green (tests cover session-scoped calls, direction rows, agents field); then the owner redlines the live board and blesses the gate.
